verdict.rationale: Mercury's in-product AI assistant 'Command' can already answer natural-language questions 'grounded in your account data' (mercury-books-supp-command), which covers the 'can we afford X?' style query, but the story specifically requires this to happen through an external agent using the API — and Mercury's own docs say the accounting API and MCP layer that would let outside agents pull live ledger data are only 'soon' (mercury-books-docs-1, mercury-books-docs-10, mercury-books-docs-11), not yet shipped. Probes confirm no live API/OpenAPI or llms.txt discovery endpoints exist today (mercury-books-probe-1, mercury-books-probe-2), so third-party agent access is unavailable. missing for 10: a shipped accounting API/MCP endpoint, evidence of an external agent actually querying live ledger data, independent confirmation of API availability.
